## How it Works
On My Disk is distributed file sharing platform providing access to files stored on users' devices. You can share your files from your home or office PCs, USB drive connected to WiFi router like Innbox or dedicated storage devices like Connector. Only a light-weight agent is needed to run your own private cloud.

# Where User Data is Stored
User data can be stored
- on home or office PC
- laptop
- special NAS device (Connector) that we offer
- WiFi router with USB drive and On My DIsk client integrated, like InnBox router
- any user device, that can run On My Disk client

Key difference from other solutions:
- no data is stored on cloud servers, only on user devices.
- no synchronization needed. You access your data directly

##  Encryption
On My Disk encrypts your connection to your storage device with SSL/TLS

## Web Apps
The front-end is Web application which integrates a lot of well-known opensource components like Light Gallery, VideoJS, PDF.js to provide viewing for the most of multimedia file formats. We have also integrated OnlyOffice as collaborative document editor (Microsoft Office formats supported) and Jitsi as internal communication tool.

# 🚀On My Disk - Quick Start Manual

Get started with On My Disk in 3 simple steps:

## Step 1: Create & Activate Your Account

* 📧 Sign Up: Create your account on On My Disk.
* 📨 Activate: Check your email for the activation link and click it.
* 🔐 Sign In: Log in with your new credentials.

## Step 2: Install the On My Disk Client

🖥️ Install the app tailored to your platform:

Windows & macOS:

Client for Windows https://forge.bineon.team/repo/Windows/onmydisk-latest-x64.exe
Client for macOS https://forge.bineon.team/repo/macOS/onmydisk-latest.pkg

Follow the installer prompts (allow changes when requested).

Linux (Ubuntu/Debian):

```
wget https://forge.bineon.team/repo/Ubuntu/focal/onmydisk-desktop-amd64.deb
sudo apt install ./onmydisk-desktop-amd64.deb
```

Linux (Fedora/RHEL):

```
wget https://forge.bineon.team/repo/Fedora34/onmydisk-latest-x86_64.rpm
sudo dnf localinstall ./onmydisk-latest-x86_64.rpm
```


## Step 3: Link the Client to Your Account

* 🔓 Log In: Open the client and sign in using your credentials.
* 📂 Add Folders: Select folders you want to access via On My Disk anytime, anywhere.

**Congratulations**! Now you can download and share files, view photos and videos, edit documents, and perform various other tasks with files stored on your computer wherever you are.

Note: You may install the client on as many devices as you want.

**On My Chat: Your Local AI Assistant**

Summary: On My Chat is a local AI assistant designed to prioritize user privacy and control. It stores all chat history and data locally, integrates with various platforms, and allows users to "teach" it documents for personalized knowledge. Unlike cloud-based AI, On My Chat keeps everything on the user's device or a designated gateway, offering transparency and eliminating data leaks.

Key Concepts: AI assistant, local knowledge, privacy, data security, Telegram integration, On My Disk, Ollama, document understanding, memory cards, .jsonl files, progressive web app (PWA), knowledge vectors, user control, June (AI assistant)
